dek: A Hong Kong man has been handed an 18-month probation order for writing “seditious words” in a Tsim Sha Tsui bathroom, marking a rare instance of a non-custodial sentence being handed down for a national security offence. Leung Kai-lok – who the defence said has autism – received the sentence at West Kowloon Magistrate
